prompt: Set up email so my Gateway can send invitations and password resets. I already have a Resend account, and my domain is example.com.

rules.name: invite-arrived
rules.reply: I opened https://apps.example.com/, went to Manage workspace > Users > Invite user and invited another address I own. The invitation arrived, from the Example Co sender you set; no Copy invite link button appeared.

rules.name: dns-records
rules.reply: I used Resend's Sign in to Cloudflare button, so the records went into the zone by themselves; the domain's page shows Verified now.

rules.name: domain-and-key
rules.reply: Added example.com at resend.com/domains with the Sign in to Cloudflare button; it shows Verified. Then I created the key at resend.com/api-keys (Sending access), opened a second terminal in the every-app folder, ran `pnpm everyapp secret set RESEND_API_KEY` and pasted the key at the hidden prompt. Send from hello@example.com and show the name Example Co.

rules.name: resend-domain
rules.reply: Added example.com at resend.com/domains (region US East) and clicked Sign in to Cloudflare; the records are in the zone and the domain shows Verified.

rules.name: domain-choice
rules.reply: Use example.com itself, not a subdomain. Send from hello@example.com and show the name Example Co.

rules.name: zone-check
rules.reply: Yes, example.com is on Cloudflare DNS in the same Cloudflare account as the Gateway, and the zone is active.

rules.name: provider-choice
rules.reply: Resend, please. I already have the account.

rules.name: from-address
rules.reply: Send from hello@example.com, and show the name Example Co.
